title: Grandmother with Young Boy and Girl in Garden, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot featuring an older woman standing proudly behind two young children along a park path. The woman wears round spectacles, a dark tilted hat, a long overcoat, and a floral corsage or medallion at her neckline. The young boy wears a belted sailor-inspired play suit with ankle socks and laced boots, while the younger child wears a light-colored dress with puffed sleeves and dark trim. Behind them, blooming flowering trees and a decorative bamboo fence frame the scene, with a passerby in a fedora walking in the background.
